metadata.scenario: A client expresses dissatisfaction with the unprofessional behavior of a staff member during their last visit. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Agnes Rodriguez. I need to talk about something that happened during my last visit. Hi, Agnes! I'm glad you called. I'm here to listen. What happened? Well, I had a companion care visit yesterday, and I was really uncomfortable with how the caregiver interacted with me. I'm very sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about what specifically made you uncomfortable? She seemed distracted and didn't engage with me at all. I felt ignored, and she even rushed through our gardening activity, which I really enjoy. That’s completely unacceptable, Agnes. We strive for quality care, and it sounds like we fell short. Yes, it was very disappointing, especially after having such good experiences before. I understand, and I appreciate you bringing this to my attention. I will investigate this matter immediately. Thank you. I just want to ensure that future visits are better. Absolutely, Agnes. Would you like me to arrange for a different caregiver for your upcoming visits? Yes, that would be great. I’d like someone who can really engage with me. I can certainly do that. I’ll make a note for the caregiver to be more interactive, especially with your gardening. I appreciate it. I really enjoy those activities. Of course! Along with that, would you be interested in adding some extra hours for companionship care? Hmm, I hadn’t thought about it, but I might be open to that. We can definitely discuss options. I can send you some details about increasing your service hours. That sounds good. Please keep me posted. I will, Agnes. I’ll also follow up with our caregiver training team regarding this incident. Thank you. I really appreciate your prompt attention to this. It’s my pleasure, Agnes. Your comfort and happiness are our top priorities. Thank you, Margaret. I hope my next visit is much better. I assure you it will be. I’ll be in touch soon with updates. Thank you. Talk to you later. Take care, Agnes. Goodbye! Goodbye!
